description: This file contains unit tests for the USB device interface, including testing device plug/unplug notifications, device list retrieval, driver binding/unbinding, and device info retrieval via RPC. It mocks libusb interactions and tests the integration with the IUSBDevice interface in a test environment.

classes.name: AsyncHandlerMock_USBDevice
classes.description: Mock class for handling asynchronous USB device events, with methods for plugged in/out notifications and waiting for specific events.

classes.name: USBDeviceNotificationHandler
classes.description: Implements the IUSBDevice::INotification interface to handle device plug/unplug events, signaling condition variables and storing device info.

classes.name: USBDeviceTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for USB device tests, managing setup, mocks, and utility functions for testing USB device interactions.

methods.name: USBDeviceTest()
methods.description: Constructor that sets up callback registration and activates the USB device service.

methods.name: ~USBDeviceTest()
methods.description: Destructor that deregisters callbacks and deactivates the service.

methods.name: WaitForRequestStatus
methods.description: Waits for a specific device event (plugged in/out) within a timeout period.

methods.name: Mock_SetDeviceDesc
methods.description: Mocks device descriptor data for a given bus number, device address, and class.

methods.name: Mock_SetSerialNumberInUSBDevicePath
methods.description: Mocks serial number files for specific USB devices.

methods.name: CreateUSBDeviceInterfaceObjectUsingComRPCConnection
methods.description: Creates a proxy object for the USB device interface via RPC connection.
